tagline: Specialty chemicals and food ingredients distribution platform serving multiple end markets
hero_kpi_rationale: The 23% revenue CAGR from 2020 to 2023 is Azelis' key growth performance indicator, reflecting its ability to leverage a resilient and fragmented business model in a specialty chemicals distribution market growing above GDP.

kpis.name: Compound annual growth rate of revenue
kpis.explanation: Average rate of revenue growth over multiple years.
kpis.description: Revenue grew at an average pace of 23% per year between 2020 and 2023.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITA margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit before amortization, expressed in basis points or as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA margin improved by 270 basis points between 2020 and 2023.

kpis.name: Cash conversion
kpis.explanation: Percentage of adjusted operating profit converted into free cash flow.
kpis.description: Average conversion of 97% of adjusted operating profit into free cash flow over 2020-2023.

kpis.name: Customer reach through exclusive mandates
kpis.explanation: Percentage of manufacturers' (principals') customer base reached by Azelis through its exclusive partnerships.
kpis.description: Azelis reaches approximately 85% of manufacturers' customers through its exclusive mandates, generating 20% of revenue.
kpis.signal: Central position in the specialty distribution value chain

kpis.name: Revenue contribution through direct relationships
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue derived from direct relationships with end customers.
kpis.description: Approximately 80% of revenue comes from direct relationships with end customers, providing consultative and technical services.
kpis.signal: Business model focused on direct customer relationships and value-added service

ai_positioning.summary: Azelis recognizes the growing role of AI and new technologies as catalysts for operational transformation and commercial efficiency, although implementation remains to be built out.
evidence: Identified megatrend: 'New technology and AI changing the way we do business'
AI significantly improves efficiency and market access
Beyond e-commerce: customers seek inspiration and technical support in addition to self-service options
Formulation expertise and LVC (Lateral Value Chain) remain key differentiators against new digital platforms from chemical producers
